design_philosophy.core_principle: Digital Showroom - Fetishize the Product, Drive the Visit.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Premium, Masculine, Confident, Timeless, 'Old Money' meets Modern City.
design_philosophy.visual_style: Sharp Luxury. High contrast. Texture over flat colors. Gold accents that feel metallic, not yellow.

typography.installation_guide: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=Bodoni+Moda:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..96,400..900;1,6..96,400..900&display=swap');

colors.strategy: Dual Theme - Default Dark for Luxury, Light for Day Shopping.

gradients.gold_shine: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] via-[#F3E5AB] to-[#D4AF37] bg-[length:200%_auto] hover:bg-right transition-all duration-500

layout_strategies.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-8 to p-24. Avoid cramped lists.
layout_strategies.border_radius: Sharp. rounded-none or rounded-sm. No big rounded-xl.

grid_systems.hero_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-auto md:h-[85vh]
grid_systems.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-6 gap-y-12

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-sm h-12 px-8 transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-transparent hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-sm h-12 px-8

cards.product: group relative bg-transparent border-none rounded-none overflow-hidden
cards.feature: bg-card border border-white/5 p-8 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-accent/30 transition-colors

navigation.style: Sticky glassmorphism. Backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-white/10
navigation.links: font-medium text-sm uppercase tracking-widest hover:text-accent transition-colors

hero_section.alt: Elegant man in black suit posing confidently

instructions_to_main_agent: PHASE 1: THEME SETUP - Update index.css with the provided HSL variables immediately. Ensure dark mode is default or toggled correctly via class.
PHASE 2: LAYOUT - Build the 'Bento Grid' Hero. Do not use a simple slider. Use a grid of images (Man in suit, Watch close up, Store interior) to show breadth of offering immediately.
PHASE 3: PRODUCT CARD - The product card must NOT have a 'Add to Cart' button. It should have 'View Details' and a WhatsApp icon corner button.
PHASE 4: MAP - Embed a Google Map iframe in the 'Visit Us' section. Make it grayscale in CSS (`filter: grayscale(100%) invert(92%) contrast(83%);`) to match the dark theme.
PHASE 5: DETAILS - Add a 'Reserve via WhatsApp' sticky button on mobile screens.
CRITICAL: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors or subtle noise textures. Use gradients ONLY for text or button hover states.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' aesthetics (generic centered text, standard blue/purple gradients).
Use 'Playfair Display' for all Headings (H1-H4). Use 'Manrope' for body text.
Buttons must be sharp (rounded-sm or rounded-none). No pill buttons.
All images must have 80-90% brightness filter in dark mode to prevent eye strain, lifting to 100% on hover.
